# Technical Reliability Analysis of Plant Monitoring Records
## Units 0000000–0000017, Stations 7–341

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Seventeen asset records spanning five equipment classes (compressors, condensers, pumps, valves, scrubbers, separators, heat exchangers, and pipelines) were reviewed for condition-based maintenance prioritization. Three units warrant **immediate corrective attention**: compressor 5806 (vibration 7.8 mm/s, ISO zone D), condenser 2223 (vibration 8.6 mm/s with a thermodynamic anomaly), and compressor 9796 (vibration 8.6 mm/s at high pressure). A further five units fall into degraded or marginal condition bands requiring scheduled intervention. Two records exhibit thermodynamically implausible signatures — condenser 2384 and pump 6876 — indicating probable instrumentation fault or data corruption that must be resolved before condition trending.

The dominant failure modes across the fleet are **bearing degradation, impeller/rotor imbalance, cavitation risk in high-flow pumps, and fouling in condensers and scrubbers.** Detailed findings and prioritized work orders follow.
